front_office: Trade EQ-1042: buy 10000 ACME shares, trade date 2026-09-14, price USD 42.15, settlement date 2026-09-16.
custodian: Trade EQ-1042: buy 9750 ACME shares, trade date 2026-09-14, price USD 42.15, settlement date 2026-09-16.
break_summary: Quantity differs by 250 shares while instrument, side, price, currency, and dates agree.
likely_root_cause: A partial allocation or late allocation update may have reached the custodian but not the front-office booking, or the remaining 250 shares may be pending in a separate allocation.
reconciliation_rule: For an affirmed trade, allocated quantity should agree across systems after all allocations are posted. Do not treat a partial allocation as a full-trade match without an approved allocation workflow.
recommended_actions: Check the allocation and affirmation status for both systems; look for a second custodian allocation or pending 250-share instruction; confirm the executing broker's allocation file; if the full quantity was intended, correct the stale booking or request a custodian amendment and rerun reconciliation.

front_office: Trade FI-2081: buy USD 2000000 face value of Northwind 4.25% 2030 notes, clean price 99.50, settlement date 2026-09-17; expected cash USD 1990000.
custodian: Trade FI-2081: buy USD 2000000 face value of Northwind 4.25% 2030 notes, dirty price 100.12, settlement date 2026-09-17; cash USD 2002400.
break_summary: Face value and security agree, but settlement cash differs by USD 12400.
likely_root_cause: The front-office amount may use clean consideration while the custodian includes accrued interest in dirty settlement cash.
reconciliation_rule: Compare like-for-like cash measures. For fixed income, settlement cash can include accrued interest; clean price alone excludes accrued interest.
recommended_actions: Compare clean price, accrued interest, day-count convention, and settlement amount components; confirm the expected measure in the reconciliation mapping; if accrued interest explains the difference, classify as a presentation/mapping break rather than altering face value.

front_office: Trade EQ-3177: sell 5000 BLUE shares, trade date 2026-09-18, settlement date 2026-09-22.
custodian: Trade EQ-3177: sell 5000 BLUE shares, trade date 2026-09-18, settlement date 2026-09-23.
break_summary: Trade economics agree except settlement date differs by one business day.
likely_root_cause: A settlement-calendar mismatch, stale settlement instruction, or incorrect market convention may have shifted the date.
reconciliation_rule: Settlement date must match the market and instrument settlement convention and the applicable business-day calendar. A date break near a holiday requires explicit calendar validation.
recommended_actions: Verify the instrument market, trade date, settlement cycle, and holiday calendar; compare the broker confirmation and standing settlement instructions; escalate promptly if the incorrect date could cause a fail, then correct the authoritative system and rerun the match.

front_office: Trade EQ-4210: buy 1200 shares, internal security ID SEC-7781, ticker OLDCO, trade date 2026-09-10.
custodian: Trade EQ-4210: buy 1200 shares, ISIN US0000007781, ticker NEWCO, trade date 2026-09-10.
break_summary: Quantity and trade date agree but the ticker and identifier differ.
likely_root_cause: A recent ticker change, corporate action, or stale security-master alias may not have propagated to both systems.
reconciliation_rule: Match securities using the approved stable identifier (such as ISIN) and effective-dated security-master aliases; ticker alone is not a stable identity.
recommended_actions: Confirm the ISIN and effective date against the security master and corporate-action notice; verify the internal-to-custodian identifier mapping; update the alias only after identity is confirmed and retain the audit trail.

front_office: Trade FX-5504: buy EUR 1000000 versus USD, value date 2026-09-21, booked currency pair EUR/USD.
custodian: Trade FX-5504: sell EUR 1000000 versus USD, value date 2026-09-21, custodian record shows USD/EUR.
break_summary: Currency-pair orientation and side appear inconsistent although the EUR notional and value date agree.
likely_root_cause: The pair may have been inverted during interface mapping, changing the interpretation of buy/sell and the quoted rate.
reconciliation_rule: FX comparisons must normalize base/quote currency orientation and compare equivalent buy/sell legs before comparing rate or cash amounts.
recommended_actions: Inspect the original deal confirmation and both currency legs; verify base/quote mapping and rate inversion logic; do not manually flip the trade until direction and both notionals are confirmed; escalate any value-date exposure.

front_office: Trade EQ-6602: buy 800 RIVER shares, broker reference BR-8890, trade date 2026-09-11.
custodian: Two custodian records, C-9921 and C-9922, both show buy 800 RIVER shares with broker reference BR-8890 and trade date 2026-09-11.
break_summary: One front-office trade appears to match two custodian records with the same broker reference.
likely_root_cause: A duplicate message may have been processed by the custodian interface, or one record may be a correction/cancel-rebook version.
reconciliation_rule: A single execution must not be counted twice. Resolve duplicates using lifecycle status and source references, not by deleting a record based only on similar economics.
recommended_actions: Check message IDs, timestamps, cancel/correct indicators, and custodian lifecycle status; confirm the actual settled position; ask the custodian to confirm before suppressing a record and preserve evidence of any duplicate correction.

front_office: Trade EQ-7314: sell 3500 ORBIT shares, trade date 2026-09-15, broker reference BR-4418; no matching custodian trade found.
custodian: No custodian record found for broker reference BR-4418 or the matching account, instrument, quantity, and trade date.
break_summary: A booked front-office sale has no matching custodian record.
likely_root_cause: The execution or allocation message may be delayed, rejected, routed to another account, or missing from the custodian feed.
reconciliation_rule: A confirmed executed trade should appear in the expected custodian account within the feed's agreed service window; pending or rejected allocations are not confirmed matches.
recommended_actions: Check feed completeness and processing timestamps, broker confirmation, allocation status, and account routing; contact the broker/custodian if the service window has passed; monitor the settlement exposure and avoid creating a duplicate trade to force a match.

front_office: Trade EQ-8459: buy 2400 MAPLE shares at USD 18.2375, trade date 2026-09-16.
custodian: Trade EQ-8459: buy 2400 MAPLE shares at USD 18.24, trade date 2026-09-16.
break_summary: Price differs by USD 0.0025 per share while the trade identity and quantity agree.
likely_root_cause: The custodian may round displayed prices to two decimal places while front office retains execution precision.
reconciliation_rule: Compare prices at the agreed precision and apply the configured instrument-specific tolerance; preserve execution precision for economics and audit.
recommended_actions: Check the source execution price and configured rounding tolerance; calculate the total cash impact; if within approved tolerance, classify as a rounding break; otherwise investigate the price feed and do not overwrite the execution price.
